comments.author: Pinnacle
comments.body: Can this be used in the Museum in Paris?

comments.author: Blake.C
comments.body:
No. Only ornaments and equipment from outside mainland Europe can used for display in the Louvre. Luckily, there's a list here on Ivyro of what ornaments and equipment can be used, and what Culture Area they belong to:

uwodbmirror.ivyro.net/eg/main.php?id=85000028

(and considering how Ivyro has not been updated in a good few years, there might be more ornaments/equipment then what's listed of what can be used there).
